metadata.title: What the Options Markets Are Saying

content.text:
LIVE
34 min ago
What the Options Markets Are Saying
Brace for volatility after Tesla's numbers come out this afternoon.
Options markets imply the stock will move about 6% up or down.
Shares have moved an average of roughly 4% after the previous four quarterly reports. They moved up once and down three times over that span.
